summary: Closing with the run at its budget limit and the record complete: all fourteen questions answered, no necessary gaps or uncited executions, and nothing further completable in the remaining seconds. The investigation's results, each backed by retained receipts, declared comparisons, witnesses and stated limits: the RestoreCommittedLogs startup replay blocks NewRaft once the committed-but-unapplied window exceeds the FSM channel's 128-batch capacity, shown at that boundary with the constructor's blocked stack under the default snapshot settings; VerifyLeader counts nonvoter acknowledgements toward a voter quorum, and under per-node timers that confirmation outlived a competing leader's election in every one of twenty trials and coincided with committed state the confirming leader had never applied in twelve of twelve, while uniform clusters kept the separation even at a one-millisecond margin; and AddVoter installs a Voter in one step against two published descriptions that promise staging, which can strand a single-voter cluster until the added server runs. Five suspicions were refuted with evidence and one behaviour entry corrected under its own id, with the narrowings later measurements forced on my own earlier readings retained in the record.
